events.name: The Crossroads of Four
events.intro: Four doors in a row at the end of a long hall: wood, iron, silver, gold. A brass sign: **"Each richer, and riskier, than the last."**

success.text: You open the plain wooden door.
You heave the iron door open.
The silver door swings open without a sound.
The gold door is warm under your hand.

events.name: Behind the Wood Door
events.intro: A snug pantry stocked for a long trip, with a kettle on and a note: **"Help yourself, traveller. Safest door in the house."**

success.text: You fill your bag with berries, and your team sits round the kettle until everyone feels a little better.

events.name: Behind the Iron Door
events.intro: A sparring hall, iron floor, iron walls, and one fighter in the middle with taped hands. "A little risk. A little reward. Spar?"

success.text: "Good." The fighter bows, and the hall rings.

events.name: Behind the Silver Door
events.intro: A glittering gallery with a single glass case in the middle and, on the case, a tiny silver alarm bell. **"Even odds,"** says the label.

success.text: The lid lifts. The bell does not ring. Inside, on velvet, something very valuable is yours.

failure.text: The bell rings. Doors slam, and the gallery's guard steps out of the shadows with a very strong team. Even odds, the label said.

success.text: You leave the case shut. Even odds are still odds.

events.name: Behind the Gold Door
events.intro: A throne room with a throne no one sits on, and a crown on a cushion. A plaque: **"Wear it, and the strongest will come for you."**

success.text: The crown fits. Something precious falls out of the cushion into your hands, and somewhere far off, the strongest trainers on the road look up. For the next three battles, they come to you.

effects.label: The crown: the next three foes are Aces

success.text: You leave the crown on its cushion. Some prizes cost more than they pay.

events.name: The Chaos Dial
events.intro: A dial on the wall with four settings that keep changing when you are not looking: wood, iron, silver, gold. **"Spin it, and step through whatever comes up."**

success.text: The dial spins and spins and clicks to a stop. A door opens beside it, and you find out which room it is by walking in.
The dial turns lazily and settles. A door opens beside it, and you find out which room it is by walking in.

events.name: The Elevator Floors
events.intro: A glass elevator with four buttons. Each floor, the little card says, is a different scene. The doors ding.

success.text: Ding. The doors open on the lobby.
Ding. Lights and noise.
Ding. It smells of clean sheets.
Ding. Wind, and a view.

events.name: Elevator: The Lobby
events.intro: A tidy lobby with a free snack table and a sign: **"Take what you need."**

success.text: Your team clears the snack table with great efficiency. Everyone feels a little better.

events.name: Elevator: The Arcade
events.intro: A tiny arcade full of blinking lights. One machine has the odds printed on it: **"Win 1 in 6. Pays 5×."**

success.text: Three bells! The machine rattles out ₽250, five times your coin.

failure.text: Bell, cherry, lemon. The machine eats your ₽50 and plays a sad tune. One in six, it said.

success.text: You leave the lights blinking.

events.name: Elevator: The Clinic
events.intro: A tiny clinic. The nurse smiles. "Right this way."

success.text: Every one of your team comes out whole, glossy and very pleased with themselves.

events.name: Elevator: The Roof
events.intro: A rooftop with a great view of the road ahead, all the way to the next stage.

success.text: You look for a long time. You can see every battle waiting on the road below, and the hidden places between them.

events.name: Twin Nodes
events.intro: Two scenes side by side at the same crossroad: a cook's camp on the left, a market stall on the right. A guide offers to rush you through both, for a price.

success.text: You take the left path, to the camp.
You take the right path, to the stall.
You pay the guide, and get both.

events.name: Twin Nodes: Left
events.intro: A tidy camp. A cook waves you over to a pot of stew.

success.text: You eat until nobody can move. Everyone is whole again.

events.name: Twin Nodes: Right
events.intro: A dusty market stall. The trader waves you in. "Small shop, fair prices."

success.text: The trader rolls up the shutters on a little shop.

events.name: Treasure vs Trap
events.intro: Two chests in a dim cellar. A hooded figure leans against the wall between them. "One is treasure, one is a trap. I always lie, or I never do. Ask me one thing."

success.text: "The left." You think about it: whether they lie or not, there is only one honest way to read that, and you work it out. You open the right chest, and it is the treasure.
"If you asked me which I'd open, I'd say the left." Asked that way, the answer is honest whoever they are. You open the left chest, and it is the treasure.

events.name: Lucky Number
events.intro: A fortune stand with three numbered cards face down. **"Pick a number. One in three wins: ten per cent more prize money, for the whole run."**

success.text: The card flips: ONE. "The road will be generous to you."

failure.text: The card flips. Not your number. "One in three," the fortune teller says kindly.

success.text: The card flips: TWO. "The road will be generous to you."

failure.text: The card flips. Not your number. "One in three," the fortune teller says kindly.

success.text: The card flips: THREE. "The road will be generous to you."

failure.text: The card flips. Not your number. "One in three," the fortune teller says kindly.

events.name: The Probability Mage
events.intro: A mage looks at you with half-closed eyes. "I will tell you what the dice want. I will not change them."

success.text: The mage tells you, plainly, what is waiting at each of the next three stops, and how likely each is to go your way.

events.name: The Stranger's Dice
events.intro: A stranger shakes a pair of old bone dice. "Roll them, and the shops on this stretch will charge what the dice say. Could be cheaper. Could be dearer."

success.text: Snake eyes, and the stranger laughs. "Lucky. Every shop on this stretch charges you eighty per cent."

failure.text: Double sixes. "Oh dear. A hundred and twenty per cent, this stretch." The stranger looks genuinely sorry.

success.text: "Suit yourself." The dice go back in a pocket.

events.name: Lucky Streak Chain
events.intro: A little stall with a chalk board: **"THREE WINS IN A ROW: PICK ANY PRIZE!"** Game one is a coin toss.

success.text: Heads! One down. "Game two, next table."

failure.text: Tails. "Better luck next time," says the stallholder, wiping your name off the board.

success.text: Tails! One down. "Game two, next table."

failure.text: Heads. "Better luck next time," says the stallholder, wiping your name off the board.

events.name: Lucky Streak Chain: Two
events.intro: Game two: three cups and one marble, shuffled very fast. One in three.

success.text: The marble! Two down. "Last game!"
The marble! Two down. "Last game!"
The marble! Two down. "Last game!"

events.name: Lucky Streak Chain: Three
events.intro: Last game: one die. Roll a five or a six. One in three, and the prize shelf is yours.

success.text: SIX! The stallholder throws their hands up and waves you at the prize shelf. You pick the best thing on it.

effects.text: Won three in a row at the streak stall.

failure.text: A three. So close. The stallholder gives you a sympathetic sweet.

events.name: The Echo Item
events.intro: A small grey stone that repeats whatever you hold up to it, not just sounds. "Show me something common," it says, in your own voice.

success.text: You hold up a Poké Ball. The stone hums, and now there are two.
You hold up a Great Ball. The stone hums, and now there are two.
You hold up a Repel. The stone hums, and now there are two.
You keep your hands in your pockets. The stone says nothing, in your voice.

events.name: The Mastery Echo
events.intro: A dojo gong with a deep, long echo that does not fade. "Ring it," says the old master, "and your next battle will teach twice."

success.text: BONGGG. The echo goes into your team and stays there, humming. The next fight will teach them double.

effects.label: The gong's echo: double experience next battle

events.name: The Reversing Mirror
events.intro: A tall mirror that shows the last thing that happened to you, backwards. In it, something you lost is coming back to you.

success.text: You step through the glass and out again, and your pockets are heavier: what you lost, the mirror gives back.

events.name: The Pocket Dimension Closet
events.intro: A wardrobe that is far bigger on the inside. A voice from somewhere among the coats: "Leave something with me. I'll keep it safe, and you'll find me again down the road."

success.text: You leave a Rare Candy on the top shelf. The door shuts softly.
You leave a Nugget on the top shelf. The door shuts softly.
You leave a Star Piece on the top shelf. The door shuts softly.
You keep your things. The wardrobe sighs, like a wardrobe.

events.name: The Closet, Again
events.intro: The same wardrobe stands at this crossroad, its door ajar, as if it has been waiting. Inside, exactly where you left it: your Rare Candy.

success.text: You take your Rare Candy back. The wardrobe gives a satisfied little creak and is gone the next time you look.

events.name: The Closet, Again
events.intro: The same wardrobe stands at this crossroad, its door ajar, as if it has been waiting. Inside, exactly where you left it: your Nugget.

success.text: You take your Nugget back. The wardrobe gives a satisfied little creak and is gone the next time you look.

events.name: The Closet, Again
events.intro: The same wardrobe stands at this crossroad, its door ajar, as if it has been waiting. Inside, exactly where you left it: your Star Piece.

success.text: You take your Star Piece back. The wardrobe gives a satisfied little creak and is gone the next time you look.

events.name: The Pokémon Census
events.intro: A clerk with a clipboard is counting Pokémon on the road. "Report your team! ₽100 for every different type in it. Variety is the spice of the census."

success.text: The clerk counts your team's types on their fingers, twice, and pays up.

events.name: The Crowd Poll
events.intro: A crowd round a stream camera. "Chat votes! Your next three fights get a boost: harder hits, or faster legs. Whatever wins!"

success.text: The votes pour in. HARDER HITS wins by a mile. For the next three battles, your team hits a little harder.

failure.text: The votes pour in. FASTER LEGS wins, just. For the next three battles, your team is a little quicker.

events.name: Challenge of the Day
events.intro: A board in the town square posts today's puzzle: a ring of nine numbered tiles to set in order. Today's prize hangs beside it in a little net.

success.text: It takes you most of an hour, with your team offering unhelpful paws. The last tile clicks home, a bell rings, and the town hands down today's prize.

events.name: The Seasonal Visitor
events.intro: A traveller dressed for the weather is handing out presents. "It's that time of year again! One each."

branches.text: A spring present: a warm egg in a nest of paper flowers.
A summer present: a jar of Honey, still warm from the sun, and a Damp Rock that smells like rain.
An autumn present: a basket of berries from the harvest.
A winter present: a Snowball, packed perfectly round, and a Heat Rock to keep your hands warm.

success.text: A present wrapped in plain paper. Inside, something useful.

events.name: The Team Banner Station
events.intro: A seamstress hangs team banners on a line between two trees. "Pick one. It's only cloth. But cloth carries a little luck."

success.text: You pick the green one. It flaps over your camp for the rest of the run, and wild Pokémon seem a little more willing.
You pick the gold one. It flaps over your camp for the rest of the run, and prize purses seem a little heavier.
You pick the red one. It flaps over your camp for the rest of the run, and your team stands a little taller.
You pick the blue one. It flaps over your camp for the rest of the run, and your team crowds under it at night.
